findings_for_partners: The docs' `infercrane deploy Qwen/Qwen3-8B --cloud kubernetes --gpu NVIDIA-L4|NVIDIA-A10G` cannot serve on a 24 GB GPU (no context bound; vLLM needs 5.62 GiB KV for 40960 tokens), and `infercrane deploy` has no flag for runtime arguments; a spec file with --max-model-len works.
A deploy that never becomes ready keeps its operation open; `infercrane delete` is refused until `infercrane operation cancel ID`.

A self-hosted control plane needs INFERCRANE_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY and INFERCRANE_WORKER_CREDENTIAL_KEY for `infercrane connect --token-env`; docs/integrations/kubernetes.mdx and docs/features/migration.mdx do not say so.
`optimize propose --provider kubernetes` proposes nothing without --include-simulated: internal/integration/catalog.go marks Kubernetes+vLLM QualificationSimulated.
With --include-simulated the planner also proposes kubernetes-dynamo setups whether or not Dynamo is installed.
The agent does not say why it does not register a server it found but judged unhealthy; only 'server is not registered with this agent' rejections appear.
docs/integrations/kubernetes.mdx:44-50: the worker-key file must not end with a newline (engines compare the key exactly); the docs do not say how to write it.
